messages.content: I live in Brisbane.
The Cobalt capstone backend used MySQL previously.
We migrated the Cobalt capstone backend to PostgreSQL; MySQL is no longer used there.
In general, I prefer Python for backend projects.
For Cobalt capstone backend work, the course requires Java only; that requirement applies to this capstone project.
The current deployment plan for the Cobalt capstone says the production region is North.
The signed client brief for the same Cobalt capstone deployment says the production region is South.
Both deployment documents are still active; I have not established which instruction controls.
